# Overview dashboard

A home row with three sections cards: who is home and the doors and windows, modes and scenes, appliances and the garden. Below it six rooms as entity group cards with the same kind of rows: lights with switches and brightness sliders, blinds with buttons and a position slider, a thermostat stepper, temperature and air rules, windows and doors. Every control here works: tap, drag and hold.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 3
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Home, icon: mdi:home }
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card-pro
      title: Who's home
      icon: mdi:shield-home
      show_icon: true
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
      sections:
        - layout: row
          align: space-between
          entities:
            - { entity: person.alex, name: Alex, visual: badge, rules: &p [{ state: home, color: green, label: Home }, { state: not_home, color: grey, label: Away }] }
            - { entity: person.sam, name: Sam, visual: badge, rules: *p }
            - { entity: person.kim, name: Kim, visual: badge, rules: *p }
        - layout: table
          divider: true
          entities:
            - { entity: binary_sensor.door_front, name: Front door, visual: badge, rules: [{ state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:door-open, label: Open }, { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:door-closed, label: Closed }] }
            - { entity: lock.front_door, name: Front door lock, control: auto, rules: [{ state: locked, color: green, label: Locked }, { state: unlocked, color: red, label: Unlocked }] }
            - { entity: binary_sensor.window_kitchen, name: Kitchen window, visual: badge, rules: &w [{ state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }, { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }] }
            - { entity: binary_sensor.window_bathroom, name: Bathroom window, visual: badge, rules: *w }
            - { entity: binary_sensor.motion_hallway, name: Hallway motion, visual: badge, rules: [{ state: "on", color: amber, icon: mdi:motion-sensor, label: Detected }, { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:motion-sensor-off, label: Clear }] }
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card-pro
      title: Modes & scenes
      icon: mdi:palette
      show_name: true
      sections:
        - layout: row
          align: space-between
          entities:
            - { entity: input_boolean.night_mode, name: Night, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: indigo }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
            - { entity: input_boolean.guest_mode, name: Guests, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: pink }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
            - { entity: input_boolean.away_mode, name: Away, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: blue }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
            - { entity: input_boolean.vacation_mode, name: Vacation, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: teal, tint_card: true }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
        - layout: row
          divider: true
          align: space-between
          name_position: below
          entities:
            - { entity: scene.bright, name: Bright, icon: mdi:white-balance-sunny, color: amber, control: button }
            - { entity: scene.dimmed, name: Dimmed, icon: mdi:lightbulb-on-50, color: orange, control: button }
            - { entity: scene.dinner, name: Dinner, icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife, color: deep-orange, control: button }
            - { entity: scene.movie_night, name: Movie, icon: mdi:movie-open, color: deep-purple, control: button }
            - { entity: scene.good_night, name: Night, icon: mdi:weather-night, color: indigo, control: button }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
    - type: custom:entity-sections-card-pro
      title: Appliances & garden
      icon: mdi:power-plug
      show_icon: true
      sections:
        - layout: table
          entities:
            - entity: sensor.washer_status
              name: Washing machine
              visual: badge
              rules:
                - { state: run, color: green, icon: mdi:washing-machine, label: Running }
                - { state: end, color: teal, icon: mdi:washing-machine-alert, label: Done }
                - { state: power_off, color: grey, icon: mdi:washing-machine-off, label: "Off" }
            - entity: sensor.dishwasher_status
              name: Dishwasher
              visual: badge
              rules:
                - { state: run, color: green, icon: mdi:dishwasher, label: Running }
                - { state: end, color: teal, icon: mdi:dishwasher-alert, label: Done }
                - { state: power_off, color: grey, icon: mdi:dishwasher-off, label: "Off" }
            - entity: vacuum.robot
              name: Robot vacuum
              visual: badge
              rules:
                - { state: cleaning, color: blue, icon: mdi:robot-vacuum, label: Cleaning }
                - { state: docked, color: green, icon: mdi:robot-vacuum, label: Docked }
                - { state: returning, color: teal, icon: mdi:home-import-outline, label: Returning }
            - { entity: switch.coffee_machine, name: Coffee machine, icon: mdi:coffee-maker, control: toggle, show_value: false }
            - entity: media_player.kitchen_speaker
              name: Kitchen speaker
              visual: badge
              rules:
                - { state: playing, color: green, icon: mdi:speaker-play, label: Playing }
                - { state: idle, color: grey, icon: mdi:speaker, label: Idle }
        - layout: row
          divider: true
          align: space-between
          entities:
            - { entity: light.garden, name: Lights, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: amber }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
            - { entity: switch.garden_pump, name: Pump, icon: mdi:water-pump, control: toggle, rules: [{ state: "on", color: blue }, { state: "off", color: grey }] }
            - { entity: cover.awning, name: Awning, icon: mdi:storefront-outline, control: hold, rules: [{ state: open, color: green }, { state: closed, color: grey }] }
            - { entity: binary_sensor.rain, name: Rain, rules: [{ state: "on", color: blue, icon: mdi:weather-rainy }, { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:weather-cloudy }] }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
- column_span: 3
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Rooms, icon: mdi:floor-plan }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
      title: Living room
      icon: mdi:sofa
      entities:
        - entity: light.living_room
          name: Ceiling light
          control: auto
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
        - entity: light.dining_table
          name: Dining table
          control: toggle
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
        - entity: cover.living_room_blinds
          name: Blinds
          icon: mdi:window-shutter
          attribute: current_position
          unit: "%"
          control: auto
        - entity: sensor.living_room_temperature
          name: Temperature
          decimals: 1
          rules:
            - { below: 19, color: blue, label: Cold }
            - { below: 24, color: green, label: Comfortable }
            - { above: 24, color: orange, label: Warm }
        - entity: sensor.living_room_co2
          name: CO₂
          visual: strip
          rules:
            - { below: 800, color: green }
            - { below: 1200, color: amber }
            - { above: 1200, color: red }
        - entity: media_player.living_room_tv
          name: TV
          visual: badge
          control: auto
          rules:
            - { state: playing, color: green, icon: mdi:play-circle, label: Playing }
            - { state: idle, color: grey, icon: mdi:television, label: Idle }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
      title: Kitchen
      icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife
      entities:
        - entity: light.kitchen
          name: Light
          control: auto
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
        - entity: sensor.kitchen_temperature
          name: Temperature
          decimals: 1
          rules:
            - { below: 19, color: blue, label: Cold }
            - { below: 24, color: green, label: Comfortable }
            - { above: 24, color: orange, label: Warm }
        - entity: sensor.kitchen_humidity
          name: Humidity
          decimals: 0
          rules:
            - { below: 40, color: amber, label: Dry }
            - { below: 65, color: green, label: Comfortable }
            - { above: 65, color: blue, label: Humid }
        - entity: binary_sensor.window_kitchen
          name: Window
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
      title: Office
      icon: mdi:desk
      entities:
        - entity: light.office
          name: Ceiling light
          control: auto
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
        - entity: light.desk_lamp
          name: Desk lamp
          control: toggle
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
        - entity: cover.office_blinds
          name: Blinds
          icon: mdi:window-shutter
          attribute: current_position
          unit: "%"
          control: auto
        - entity: sensor.office_temperature
          name: Temperature
          decimals: 1
          rules:
            - { below: 19, color: blue, label: Cold }
            - { below: 24, color: green, label: Comfortable }
            - { above: 24, color: orange, label: Warm }
        - entity: sensor.office_co2
          name: CO₂
          visual: strip
          rules:
            - { below: 800, color: green }
            - { below: 1200, color: amber, label: Stuffy }
            - { above: 1200, color: red, label: Ventilate }
        - entity: binary_sensor.window_office
          name: Window
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
      title: Bedroom
      icon: mdi:bed
      entities:
        - entity: light.bedroom
          name: Light
          control: auto
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
        - entity: cover.bedroom_blinds
          name: Blinds
          icon: mdi:window-shutter
          attribute: current_position
          unit: "%"
          control: auto
        - entity: sensor.bedroom_temperature
          name: Temperature
          decimals: 1
          rules:
            - { below: 17, color: blue, label: Cold }
            - { below: 21, color: green, label: Good for sleep }
            - { above: 21, color: orange, label: Warm }
        - entity: climate.bedroom
          name: Heating
          icon: mdi:radiator
          attribute: temperature
          unit: °C
          control: stepper
          rules:
            - { state: heat, color: orange, label: Heating }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
        - entity: binary_sensor.window_bedroom
          name: Window
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
      title: Bathroom
      icon: mdi:shower
      entities:
        - entity: sensor.bathroom_humidity
          name: Humidity
          visual: bar
          min: 30
          max: 100
          rules:
            - { below: 60, color: green }
            - { below: 70, color: amber, label: Humid }
            - { above: 70, color: red, label: Ventilate }
        - entity: sensor.bathroom_temperature
          name: Temperature
          decimals: 1
          rules:
            - { below: 20, color: blue, label: Cold }
            - { below: 25, color: green, label: Comfortable }
            - { above: 25, color: orange, label: Warm }
        - entity: binary_sensor.window_bathroom
          name: Window
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card-pro
      title: Hallway
      icon: mdi:door
      entities:
        - entity: light.hallway
          name: Light
          control: auto
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
        - entity: sensor.hallway_temperature
          name: Temperature
          decimals: 1
          rules:
            - { below: 19, color: blue, label: Cold }
            - { below: 24, color: green, label: Comfortable }
            - { above: 24, color: orange, label: Warm }
        - entity: binary_sensor.door_front
          name: Front door
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:door-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:door-closed, label: Closed }
        - entity: binary_sensor.motion_hallway
          name: Motion
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, icon: mdi:motion-sensor, label: Detected }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:motion-sensor-off, label: Clear }
        - entity: sensor.motion_hallway_battery
          name: Sensor battery
          visual: ring
          rules:
            - { below: 20, color: red, label: Replace }
            - { below: 50, color: amber }
            - { above: 50, color: green }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
```

</DashboardGrid>
